stories.summary: President Trump has appointed Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton as the new US AI czar to lead the newly formed White House task force.

stories.title: QCOM Is Reportedly In Advanced Talks For $4B Acquisition Of AI Startup Modular
stories.summary: Qualcomm is reportedly in advanced talks to acquire AI startup Modular for approximately $4 billion to strengthen its hardware-software integration.
